macros.name: annexstyle
macros.doc: The style of the annex title is determined by the \annexstyle macro, which is defined as follows: \newcommand\annexstyle{\MakeUppercase}.

macros.name: correctionstyle
macros.doc: The style defined by \correctionstyle will be applied to the title as well as the entire environment.

macros.name: enumfont
macros.doc: the font of all enumeration labels may be changed by redefining \enumfont (\bfseries by default).

macros.name: exercise
